sentences.text: He was sentenced to undergo ten years rigorous imprisonment.
He also suffered imprisonments for similar period for other offences also in the very same case.
The petitioner seeks emergency leave for his father.
The petitioner states that his mother is https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis suffering from serious ailments and that therefore, leave may be granted.
The petitioner's request was rejected vide order dated 07.12.2024 by the second respondent.

3.When the matter was taken up for hearing, the learned Additional Public Prosecutor submitted that enquiry reveals that the petitioner's mother is hale and healthy and that the reason set out in the affidavit filed in support of the writ petition is false.
No convincing material has been placed before us in support of the petitioner's claim.
We are not satisfied that relief has to be granted.
4.This writ petition is dismissed accordingly.
No costs.
